user.title: Connect the Iliadbox
user.description: Local address of the box, e.g. 192.168.1.254. Home Assistant must be on the box network.

data_description.host: Local IP address or hostname of the box.
data_description.port: 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS. With HTTPS on, port 80 is changed to 443 automatically.
data_description.use_ssl: Encrypt the traffic between Home Assistant and the box.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only with HTTPS. Turn it off to accept the box self-signed certificate, or when connecting by IP address (the certificate is issued for a hostname, not for the IP).

reconfigure.title: Change the Iliadbox connection
reconfigure.description: Update address, port or HTTPS settings. The current authorization is kept.

link.title: Authorize Home Assistant
link.description:
An access request for "Home Assistant" appeared on the Iliadbox ({host}) display: accept it with the box button, then press Submit.

Afterwards, in myiliadbox → Access management → Applications you can grant the "Modify settings" permission (needed for the Wi-Fi switch and reboot).

error.ssl_error: The box certificate could not be verified. Turn off "Verify the certificate" to accept the self-signed certificate (needed when connecting by IP address).
error.invalid_auth: The box rejected the current authorization. Remove and add the integration again.
error.not_confirmed: Request not confirmed on the box yet.
error.auth_denied: Request denied on the box. Press Submit to create a new one.
error.auth_timeout: Request timed out. Press Submit to create a new one.

abort.wrong_box: This address belongs to a different box than the configured one.

init.title: Iliadbox settings
init.description: Connection changes are tested on the box before saving. The integration reloads after saving; no new authorization is needed.

data_description.host: Local IP address or hostname of the box.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the box is read, in seconds (10-3600). Shorter means faster presence detection and more requests to the box.
data_description.log_level: Error: failures only. Info: also connections, Wi-Fi and device presence changes. Debug: also every API call.
